g.title: delft3d4_communication
g.text: Delft3D4 online: Delft3D4 controls the time loop, with synchronized file exchange

g.title: fi
g.text: Initialize Delft3D4 and the DelftIO connection

g.title: read
g.text: Read wave fields at the Delft3D4 read point

g.title: finish
g.text: End: Delft3D4 sends the DelftIO finalize command; both components clean up.
Solid arrows: file I/O or local sequence. Dashed arrows: inter-component control.
* Requires WriteCOM (mandatory online); the Delft3D4 input selections are independent of it.
